description: The component is versatile in its application scenarios, such as comparing actual output values with target values; or contrasting similar data with historical data from the same period. It is user-friendly and allows for a clear view of the differences in data. The component can set individual styles for the actual values and target values, as well as display methods for the comparison results: specific values, percentages, and different styles can be applied to highlight the differences. It can intuitively show whether the data is increasing or decreasing and display the difference value. Additionally, the component provides unit conversion for data and can clearly display large datasets within the chart.
